report.advertisedClaim: The offer page does not advertise free cancellation with full refund up to 24 hours before departure. Instead, it describes a 24-hour risk-free cancellation period after purchase, and otherwise, cancellations may incur fees or result in eCredit, depending on ticket type.
report.policyFinding: The policy page is a 404 error and does not provide any information on cancellation or refund policies.
report.explanation: No verifiable policy excerpt supports a firm verdict, so this is marked unverified. The offer page does not support the claim of free cancellation with full refund up to 24 hours before departure. Instead, Delta offers a 24-hour risk-free cancellation period after ticket purchase, during which you can cancel for a full refund. After this period, cancellation policies depend on ticket type: non-refundable tickets (such as Basic or Classic) may only be canceled for an eCredit minus fees, and only refundable tickets are eligible for a full refund after the risk-free period. The policy page is unavailable and provides no further details.
importantConditions: 24-hour risk-free cancellation applies only within 24 hours of purchase, not up to 24 hours before departure.
Non-refundable tickets canceled after the risk-free period receive eCredit minus fees, not a full refund.
Refundable tickets can be refunded after the risk-free period, but only if the ticket is refundable.
Cancellations must be made prior to departure.

evidence.excerpt: You have one day from the time of purchase to cancel or change your eTicket for any reason and receive a full refund — including any prepaid fees and Direct Ticketing Charges — with no cancellation fee.

If you purchased a non-refundable ticket such as Basic or Classic Travel Experience, you may cancel your ticket prior to departure and receive an eCredit, minus any applicable fees. The remaining value of your ticket after applicable fees are deducted will be issued as an eCredit.
Find information on how to request a refund for your Extra or refundable ticket. Follow the steps to cancel your ticket or other purchase prior to departure.

unansweredQuestions: What are the exact fees for canceling non-refundable tickets after the risk-free period?
Are there any exceptions or special cases for full refunds beyond the risk-free period?
nextSteps: Check your ticket type (refundable or non-refundable) in your Delta account or confirmation email.
If you are within 24 hours of purchase, cancel online for a full refund.
If outside the 24-hour window, review your ticket's cancellation terms for possible fees or eCredit eligibility.
Contact Delta customer service for clarification if your situation is not addressed online.
